# sauth_merge_policy (Resource)

The merge_policy records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `auto_merge_mode` (String) when accounts that share a verified email merge
- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references

### Optional

- `trust_custom_providers` (Boolean) whether custom external providers count as verifying the email
